description: Introduce useFactoryDocumentSave as the single React Query mutation seam for persisting a full canonical factory document to the active session factory API, then migrate graph editor and worker/workstation detail-card saves to use it while preserving existing save UX, operator error codes, and cache coherence.

context.customerAsk: useFactoryDocumentSave shared by graph and detail cards. Full spec: tasks/prd-ui-factory-document-save-hook.md
context.problem: Graph editor, workstation detail, and worker detail each duplicate save mutation logic—confirm/submitting state, scope keys, stale-version handling, operator error mapping, and React Query cache updates—while all ultimately PUT the same session factory document.
context.solution: Add useFactoryDocumentSave as the one feature-level hook wrapping saveSessionFactory/current-factory save adapters; migrate graph and detail-card call sites to call it after local patches; keep draft and confirm UX in feature hooks; centralize cache updates and error codes in the shared hook.

acceptanceCriteria: useFactoryDocumentSave is the production mutation entry point for graph editor save and worker/workstation detail-card saves.
Successful saves update both currentFactoryDocumentQueryKey and currentFactoryDefinitionQueryKey for the active session without manual invalidation from callers.
Operator failures STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, and INVALID_FACTORY surface with stable code values for existing recovery UX.
Graph editor save summary, active-work blocking, confirm-save, and confirm-leave behavior is unchanged after migration.
Workstation and worker detail cards preserve confirm-save, scope-key error isolation, submitting state, and localized error copy.
Feature code does not call saveCurrentFactoryDocument directly; that API remains for the hook layer and API tests.
Quality gate: UI typecheck, lint, and affected unit tests pass before merge.

userStories.title: Shared factory document save hook
userStories.description: As a feature developer, I want one mutation hook for persisting a full factory document so every save path shares transport, cache updates, and error mapping.
acceptanceCriteria: useFactoryDocumentSave is exported from the current-factory-definition (or factory-document) feature hooks surface with save, saveAsync, isPending, error, and reset.
Input accepts mode (default REPLACE_CURRENT), factory, optional baseVersion, and optional sessionID defaulting from useDashboardSession.
The hook calls session factory save transport without mutating the caller factory object in place.
onSuccess updates currentFactoryDocumentQueryKey and currentFactoryDefinitionQueryKey for the resolved session.
Rejected errors expose code STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, or INVALID_FACTORY when the API returns those outcomes.
Unit tests cover success cache update, default mode, session override, and mapped error codes.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
